name: Hats
summary: Card exchange game where players collect hat cards to score based on final table board positions and a hidden favorite hat.
rules_text: Shuffle 42 hat cards (7 types with numbers). Fill 5 spaces (2p) or 6 spaces (3-4p) on tea table board from deck. Deal 9 cards to each player. On your turn, either Exchange Hats: play one card from hand face up and swap it with a board card if same type or your number is higher, taking the board card to your tableau; or Create a Black Hat: play a card face down to your tableau worth 1 point. Once per turn you may discard one card to draw. In 4p teams, partners sit opposite and may instead exchange one card face down with partner, talking vaguely but not naming type, color, or number. Game ends after each player has placed 8 cards. Reveal last card in hand as favorite type. If a type appears multiple times on board, only the lowest-position copy scores, others score zero. Score: each collected card scores points equal to board position of its type, black hats 1, types not on board 0. Favorite bonus is sum of your collection matching favorite type minus value of favorite card. Cookie (5 pts) goes during play to player with most distinct types including black, tie broken by lowest card values. Highest total wins.
rating_reason: Card exchange set collection, hidden hands, turn-based strategic.
